audit_status.source_base: Greek 2 Peter text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact draft reviewed for mockers, day of Lord, cosmic dissolution imagery, patience, new heavens/earth, Paul's letters, growth in grace.

verses.restored: This already, beloved, is second letter I write to you, in which I awaken your sincere mind by reminder,

familiar.text: This second epistle, beloved, I now write unto you; in both which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance:

modern.text: Beloved, this is now my second letter to you. Both of them are reminders to stir you to wholesome thinking

original.text: Ταύτην ἤδη, ἀγαπητοί, δευτέραν ὑμῖν γράφω ἐπιστολήν, ἐν αἷς διεγείρω ὑμῶν ἐν ὑπομνήσει τὴν εἰλικρινῆ διάνοιαν,

verses.restored: to remember the words spoken before by the holy prophets and command of the Lord and Savior through your apostles.

familiar.text: That ye may be mindful of the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and of the commandment of us the apostles of the Lord and Saviour:

modern.text: by recalling what was foretold by the holy prophets and commanded by our Lord and Savior through your apostles.

original.text: μνησθῆναι τῶν προειρημένων ῥημάτων ὑπὸ τῶν ἁγίων προφητῶν καὶ τῆς τῶν ἀποστόλων ὑμῶν ἐντολῆς τοῦ κυρίου καὶ σωτῆρος,

verses.restored: Knowing this first, that in last days mockers will come with mockery, going according to their own desires,

familiar.text: Knowing this first, that there shall come in the last days scoffers, walking after their own lusts,

modern.text: Most importantly, you must understand that in the last days scoffers will come, scoffing and following their own evil desires.

original.text: τοῦτο πρῶτον γινώσκοντες ὅτι ἐλεύσονται ἐπʼ ⸀ἐσχάτων τῶν ἡμερῶν ⸂ἐν ἐμπαιγμονῇ⸃ ἐμπαῖκται κατὰ τὰς ἰδίας ἐπιθυμίας αὐτῶν πορευόμενοι

verses.restored: and saying, Where is the promise of his presence/arrival? For since the fathers fell asleep, all things remain thus from beginning of creation.

familiar.text: And saying, Where is the promise of his coming? for since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.

modern.text: “Where is the promise of His coming?” they will ask. “Ever since our fathers fell asleep, everything continues as it has from the beginning of creation.”

original.text: καὶ λέγοντες· Ποῦ ἐστιν ἡ ἐπαγγελία τῆς παρουσίας αὐτοῦ; ἀφʼ ἧς γὰρ οἱ πατέρες ἐκοιμήθησαν, πάντα οὕτως διαμένει ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς κτίσεως.

verses.restored: For this escapes their notice willingly, that heavens existed long ago and earth was formed out of water and through water by word of Divine,

familiar.text: For this they willingly are ignorant of, that by the word of God the heavens were of old, and the earth standing out of the water and in the water:

modern.text: But they deliberately overlook the fact that long ago by God’s word the heavens existed and the earth was formed out of water and by water,

original.text: λανθάνει γὰρ αὐτοὺς τοῦτο θέλοντας ὅτι οὐρανοὶ ἦσαν ἔκπαλαι καὶ γῆ ἐξ ὕδατος καὶ διʼ ὕδατος συνεστῶσα τῷ τοῦ θεοῦ λόγῳ,

verses.restored: through which the world then was flooded with water and perished.

familiar.text: Whereby the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished:

modern.text: through which the world of that time perished in the flood.

original.text: ⸂διʼ ὧν⸃ ὁ τότε κόσμος ὕδατι κατακλυσθεὶς ἀπώλετο·

verses.restored: But the present heavens and earth by the same word have been stored for fire, being kept for day of judgment and ruin of irreverent humans.

familiar.text: But the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word are kept in store, reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men.

modern.text: And by that same word, the present heavens and earth are reserved for fire, being kept for the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men. The Day of the Lord (Zephaniah 1:7–18; Malachi 4:1–6; 1 Thessalonians 5:1–11)

original.text: οἱ δὲ νῦν οὐρανοὶ καὶ ἡ γῆ τῷ ⸀αὐτῷ λόγῳ τεθησαυρισμένοι εἰσὶν πυρὶ τηρούμενοι εἰς ἡμέραν κρίσεως καὶ ἀπωλείας τῶν ἀσεβῶν ἀνθρώπων.

verses.restored: But let this one thing not escape you, beloved: one day with Lord is as thousand years, and thousand years as one day.

familiar.text: But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.

modern.text: Beloved, do not let this one thing escape your notice: With the Lord a day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years are like a day.

original.text: Ἓν δὲ τοῦτο μὴ λανθανέτω ὑμᾶς, ἀγαπητοί, ὅτι μία ἡμέρα παρὰ κυρίῳ ὡς χίλια ἔτη καὶ χίλια ἔτη ὡς ἡμέρα μία.

verses.restored: The Lord is not slow concerning the promise, as some consider slowness, but is patient toward you, not willing any to perish but all to come into turning/realignment.

familiar.text: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

modern.text: The Lord is not slow in keeping His promise as some understand slowness, but is patient with you, not wanting anyone to perish but everyone to come to repentance.

original.text: οὐ βραδύνει ⸀κύριος τῆς ἐπαγγελίας, ὥς τινες βραδύτητα ἡγοῦνται, ἀλλὰ μακροθυμεῖ εἰς ⸀ὑμᾶς, μὴ βουλόμενός τινας ἀπολέσθαι ἀλλὰ πάντας εἰς μετάνοιαν χωρῆσαι.

verses.restored: But day of Lord will come like unexpected thief; in it heavens will pass away with roar, elements being burned will be released, and earth and works in it will be found/exposed.

familiar.text: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat, the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.

modern.text: But the Day of the Lord will come like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a roar, the elements will be destroyed by fire, and the earth and its works will be laid bare.

original.text: ἥξει δὲ ⸀ἡμέρα κυρίου ὡς ⸀κλέπτης, ἐν ᾗ οἱ οὐρανοὶ ῥοιζηδὸν παρελεύσονται, στοιχεῖα δὲ καυσούμενα ⸀λυθήσεται, καὶ γῆ καὶ τὰ ἐν αὐτῇ ἔργα ⸀εὑρεθήσεται.

verses.restored: All these things thus being released, what sort of people must you be in holy conduct and reverence/godliness,

familiar.text: Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness,

modern.text: Since everything will be destroyed in this way, what kind of people ought you to be? You ought to conduct yourselves in holiness and godliness

original.text: Τούτων ⸀οὕτως πάντων λυομένων ποταποὺς δεῖ ὑπάρχειν ὑμᾶς ἐν ἁγίαις ἀναστροφαῖς καὶ εὐσεβείαις,

verses.restored: expecting and hastening the presence/arrival of the day of Divine, because of which heavens being set aflame will be released and elements burning will melt.

familiar.text: Looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of God, wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat?

modern.text: as you anticipate and hasten the coming of the day of God, when the heavens will be destroyed by fire and the elements will melt in the heat.

original.text: προσδοκῶντας καὶ σπεύδοντας τὴν παρουσίαν τῆς τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμέρας, διʼ ἣν οὐρανοὶ πυρούμενοι λυθήσονται καὶ στοιχεῖα καυσούμενα τήκεται·

verses.restored: But according to his promise we expect new heavens and new earth, in which righteousness/justice dwells.

familiar.text: Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness.

modern.text: But in keeping with God’s promise, we are looking forward to a new heaven and a new earth, where righteousness dwells. Final Exhortations

original.text: καινοὺς δὲ οὐρανοὺς καὶ γῆν καινὴν κατὰ τὸ ἐπάγγελμα αὐτοῦ προσδοκῶμεν, ἐν οἷς δικαιοσύνη κατοικεῖ.

verses.restored: Therefore, beloved, expecting these things, be eager to be found spotless and blameless by him in peace.

familiar.text: Wherefore, beloved, seeing that ye look for such things, be diligent that ye may be found of him in peace, without spot, and blameless.

modern.text: Therefore, beloved, as you anticipate these things, make every effort to be found at peace—spotless and blameless in His sight.

original.text: Διό, ἀγαπητοί, ταῦτα προσδοκῶντες σπουδάσατε ἄσπιλοι καὶ ἀμώμητοι αὐτῷ εὑρεθῆναι ἐν εἰρήνῃ,

verses.restored: And consider the patience of our Lord as salvation/healing, just as also our beloved sibling Paul wrote to you according to the wisdom given to him,

familiar.text: And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given unto him hath written unto you;

modern.text: Consider also that our Lord’s patience brings salvation, just as our beloved brother Paul also wrote you with the wisdom God gave him.

original.text: καὶ τὴν τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν μακροθυμίαν σωτηρίαν ἡγεῖσθε, καθὼς καὶ ὁ ἀγαπητὸς ἡμῶν ἀδελφὸς Παῦλος κατὰ τὴν ⸂δοθεῖσαν αὐτῷ⸃ σοφίαν ἔγραψεν ὑμῖν,

verses.restored: as also in all letters, speaking in them concerning these things, in which there are some hard-to-understand things, which the unlearned and unstable twist, as also the rest of Scriptures, to their own destruction.

familiar.text: As also in all his epistles, speaking in them of these things; in which are some things hard to be understood, which they that are unlearned and unstable wrest, as they do also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction.

modern.text: He writes this way in all his letters, speaking in them about such matters. Some parts of his letters are hard to understand, which ignorant and unstable people distort, as they do the rest of the Scriptures, to their own destruction.

original.text: ὡς καὶ ἐν πάσαις ⸀ταῖς ἐπιστολαῖς λαλῶν ἐν αὐταῖς περὶ τούτων, ἐν ⸀αἷς ἐστιν δυσνόητά τινα, ἃ οἱ ἀμαθεῖς καὶ ἀστήρικτοι ⸀στρεβλοῦσιν ὡς καὶ τὰς λοιπὰς γραφὰς πρὸς τὴν ἰδίαν αὐτῶν ἀπώλειαν.

verses.restored: You therefore, beloved, knowing beforehand, guard yourselves so that you are not carried away by error of lawless ones and fall from your own stability.

familiar.text: Ye therefore, beloved, seeing ye know these things before, beware lest ye also, being led away with the error of the wicked, fall from your own stedfastness.

modern.text: Therefore, beloved, since you already know these things, be on your guard so that you will not be carried away by the error of the lawless and fall from your secure standing.

original.text: ὑμεῖς οὖν, ἀγαπητοί, προγινώσκοντες φυλάσσεσθε ἵνα μὴ τῇ τῶν ἀθέσμων πλάνῃ συναπαχθέντες ἐκπέσητε τοῦ ἰδίου στηριγμοῦ,

verses.restored: But grow in grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Messiah. To him be glory both now and into day of age. Amen.

familiar.text: But grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and for ever. Amen.

modern.text: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To Him be the glory both now and to the day of eternity. Amen.

original.text: αὐξάνετε δὲ ἐν χάριτι καὶ γνώσει τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν καὶ σωτῆρος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ. αὐτῷ ἡ δόξα καὶ νῦν καὶ εἰς ἡμέραν αἰῶνος. ⸀ἀμήν.

translation_notes: Day-of-Lord imagery is apocalyptic purification/exposure language, not a sensational timetable.
The Lord's patience is explicitly salvation/healing and desire for all to come to turning/realignment.
New heavens and new earth are defined by righteousness/justice dwelling.
